tasks.title: Generate local secrets and .env scaffolding (no echo)
tasks.description: Create gitignored .env files for api/web/workers and committed .env.example templates (placeholders only) covering every variable in ENV_VARS.md. Generate tooling-producible secrets and write them into api/.env WITHOUT echoing values to stdout, logs, or git: Active Record Encryption keys (bin/rails db:encryption:init), a VAPID public/private keypair + VAPID_SUBJECT, SESSION_SECRET, APP_SHARED_SECRET, and WORKER_SERVICE_TOKEN (write the same WORKER_SERVICE_TOKEN into workers/.env). Externally-sourced secrets (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET, RESEND_INBOUND_DOMAIN) are owner-provided: if already present in api/.env leave them untouched, otherwise add empty placeholder keys. Ensure every real .env is gitignored. Never print, log, or commit any secret value.
acceptance_criteria: .env.example committed for api, web, and workers with every ENV_VARS.md variable as a placeholder
Gitignored api/.env, web/.env, workers/.env exist and are not tracked by git
AR encryption keys, VAPID keypair+subject, SESSION_SECRET, APP_SHARED_SECRET, WORKER_SERVICE_TOKEN populated in api/.env; identical WORKER_SERVICE_TOKEN in workers/.env
Owner-provided external secret keys (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET, RESEND_INBOUND_DOMAIN) present, either preserved or as empty placeholders
No secret value appears in command output, logs, or git diff

tasks.title: Provision Railway project, services, and Postgres via CLI
tasks.description: OWNER-AUTHORIZED infra task. Using the authenticated Railway CLI, create the Waunder project (railway init), add three services (web, api, worker) and a managed PostgreSQL plugin, and push environment variables from the local .env files via railway variables --set for each service, reading values from .env WITHOUT echoing them. Wire API_INTERNAL_URL (api private-network URL) on web and worker, and set an identical WORKER_SERVICE_TOKEN on api and worker. Do NOT build/deploy images and do NOT run production migrations in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Railway project exists with web, api, worker services and a managed Postgres plugin
Per-service variables set from .env (verified by key presence via railway variables; values never printed)
API_INTERNAL_URL wired on web and worker; identical WORKER_SERVICE_TOKEN on api and worker
No secret value echoed to output; no deploy or production migration triggered

tasks.title: Shared-secret session and worker bearer auth in Api::BaseController
tasks.description: Implement RESOLVED-14. Add POST /api/session that compares the posted passphrase to APP_SHARED_SECRET and on match sets a signed, HTTP-only session cookie (signed with SESSION_SECRET); add DELETE /api/session to clear it. Add a before_action in Api::BaseController enforcing a valid session on all /api endpoints except health. Add a separate worker-auth guard that authenticates Authorization: Bearer <WORKER_SERVICE_TOKEN> for worker-facing endpoints. Return the consistent JSON error shape on auth failure. Read all secrets from env only.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/session with correct passphrase sets a signed HTTP-only cookie and returns 200; wrong passphrase returns 401
Protected /api endpoint returns 401 without a session and 200 with one; health is reachable without a session
Worker bearer guard accepts a valid WORKER_SERVICE_TOKEN and rejects missing/invalid tokens
Request specs cover session success/failure, protected-endpoint gating, and worker bearer cases

tasks.title: JobPost, Company, ApplicationRoute schema and models
tasks.description: Migrations and models for Company, JobPost, and ApplicationRoute. ApplicationRoute stores source URL, canonical posting URL, application URL, a route_type enum (company_careers, greenhouse, lever, ashby, workday, linkedin_easy_apply, indeed_apply, glassdoor_apply, unknown), recommended route, and route confidence. JobPost holds normalized posting fields plus columns for scoring results, belongs_to Company, and has_one ApplicationRoute. Enforce foreign keys at the database level.
acceptance_criteria: Migrations create companies, job_posts, and application_routes with DB-level FK constraints
route_type is constrained to the nine documented values
Models define associations and validations; bin/rails db:migrate runs clean
Model specs pass

tasks.title: Application, ApplicationDraft, AuditEvent schema and models

Enforce foreign keys at the database level.
acceptance_criteria: Migrations create applications, application_drafts, and audit_events with DB-level FK constraints
Application status is enum-constrained to the documented lifecycle values
Models define associations and validations; migrate runs clean
Model specs pass

tasks.title: Profile and ResumeDocument with encrypted sensitive fields
tasks.description: Migrations and models for Profile (structured profile capture) and ResumeDocument (uploaded resume plus parsed structure). Sensitive resume/profile fields use Active Record Encryption (encrypts :field, deterministic where the field must remain queryable). Sensitive fields are never stored in plaintext.
acceptance_criteria: Migrations create profiles and resume_documents
Sensitive fields are encrypted at rest via Active Record Encryption
Model spec verifies ciphertext is stored in the column while the accessor returns plaintext
migrate runs clean and rubocop is clean

tasks.title: ContactCandidate and OutreachDraft schema and models

acceptance_criteria: Migrations create contact_candidates and outreach_drafts with DB-level FK constraints
ContactCandidate links to a JobPost and records a relevance reason
Models define associations and validations; migrate runs clean
Model specs pass

tasks.title: Resend inbound webhook endpoint with Svix verification
tasks.description: Add POST /webhooks/resend/inbound (outside session auth) that verifies the Svix signature (svix-id/svix-timestamp/svix-signature) against RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET, parses the email.received payload, persists the raw inbound email, and enqueues a solid_queue parse job. Reject invalid or missing signatures with 401. Guard live behavior behind presence of RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Log identifiers and status only, never email PII.
acceptance_criteria: Valid Svix signature returns 200 and enqueues a parse job; invalid/missing signature returns 401
Raw inbound email is persisted
Endpoint is not session-guarded (provider-signature auth only)
Request spec covers valid and invalid signatures; no PII is logged

Live-wiring (deferred to deploy): once the public URL exists, create the Resend email.received webhook via CLI profile waunder pointing at the deployed /webhooks/resend/inbound URL, capture its Svix signing secret into RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET (api service + api/.env, never echoed), and ensure receiving is enabled on ubcpsych.com with MX records configured

tasks.title: Deterministic known-sender email parser to normalized JobPost
tasks.description: Implement deterministic parsers for known job-alert senders (LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor) that extract postings from a forwarded alert into normalized JobPost records (title, company, location, source URL, posting URL). Prefer deterministic parsing; when no known-sender parser matches, persist the raw content and flag it for LLM fallback (consumed by LLM scoring). Isolate parsing in a tested service object; no live external calls in tests.
acceptance_criteria: Known-sender fixtures parse into JobPost rows with expected normalized fields
Unknown-sender input is persisted and flagged for fallback, never silently dropped
Parser is a service object covered by unit tests with no live external calls

tasks.title: Deterministic ATS detection and route-preference ranking
tasks.description: Implement deterministic ApplicationRoute resolution: detect route_type from URL patterns (greenhouse/lever/ashby/workday/linkedin/indeed/glassdoor/company_careers/unknown) and rank to a recommended application route using the preference order (direct ATS/company application URL > company careers > job-board external apply > LinkedIn/Indeed/Glassdoor apply > manual only), recording a route confidence. Fall back to the LLM only when no pattern matches. Runs in the ingest pipeline after normalization.
acceptance_criteria: URL fixtures map to the correct route_type
Recommended route follows the documented preference order and records a confidence
Resolution logic is deterministic and tested without invoking the LLM
Resolution runs in the pipeline after JobPost normalization

tasks.title: Manual job/link entry endpoint
tasks.description: Add an authenticated POST /api/job_posts accepting a URL and/or pasted text (RESOLVED-16), creating a JobPost and running it through the same normalize -> route-resolve -> score pipeline as email ingestion. Session-guarded; consistent JSON error shape on invalid input.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated POST creates a JobPost and enqueues the normalize/route/score pipeline
Unauthenticated request returns 401
Invalid input returns the consistent JSON error shape
Request spec covers success and failure cases

tasks.title: OpenRouter client (structured JSON, env model, key-guarded)
tasks.description: Implement an OpenRouter client service reading OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_MODEL (default google/gemma-4-31b-it:free). Request structured JSON where supported and degrade gracefully (retry / parse-fallback) given free-tier rate limits and looser schema guarantees. Raise a typed error when the API key is absent so callers can guard/skip. Isolate as a client object, never inline in controllers. Never log prompt/completion contents containing PII.
acceptance_criteria: Client builds requests using OPENROUTER_MODEL from env (default applied when unset)
Missing API key raises a typed error rather than crashing
Structured-JSON parsing with graceful fallback is covered by tests against mocked responses
No live external calls in tests; no PII logged

tasks.title: Job scoring and summary background job
tasks.description: solid_queue job that scores a normalized JobPost via the OpenRouter client and writes structured results to the JobPost: summary, match score, relevant requirements, missing/weak requirements, resume alignment notes, suggested application strategy, and red flags. Also serves as the LLM fallback for postings the deterministic parser flagged. Skips gracefully (marks skipped, no error) when no API key is configured.
acceptance_criteria: Job populates the scoring/summary fields on JobPost from mocked LLM JSON
Parser-flagged fallback postings are scored through the same job
With no API key the job no-ops/marks skipped without raising
Job spec uses a mocked OpenRouter client; no PII logged

tasks.title: Application draft and autofill payload generation
tasks.description: solid_queue job/service generating an ApplicationDraft for a JobPost + Profile: tailored resume emphasis notes, a cover letter/message draft, structured application answers, and an autofill payload keyed to the resolved route's ATS shape. Uses encrypted Profile/ResumeDocument data and never logs PII. Skips gracefully when no API key is configured.
acceptance_criteria: Produces an ApplicationDraft with an autofill payload matching the resolved route's ATS shape
Draft generation incorporates Profile/ResumeDocument data
With no API key the job skips gracefully without raising
Spec uses a mocked LLM client; no PII logged

tasks.title: Resume upload and structured profile API
tasks.description: Ingest the resume from the external portfolio project's canonical JSON Resume, pushed to POST /api/profile/resume (push-on-export). ResumeJsonImporter maps it deterministically (no LLM, no PDF/OCR parsing) into the singleton Profile and a primary ResumeDocument: structured fields + parsed_structure from the JSON, raw_text from the markdown, and the PDF attached via Active Storage. Session-guarded; GET/PATCH /api/profile read/update the structured Profile exposing encrypted PII as presence flags only; sensitive data encrypted at rest and never logged. Manual upload (WEB-04) is a fallback on the same endpoint. See RESOLVED-18.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated resume upload stores a ResumeDocument with encrypted sensitive fields
Profile GET and PATCH read/update the structured profile
Unauthenticated requests return 401
Request specs cover success, auth failure, and encrypted-at-rest storage

tasks.title: PushSubscription model, subscribe endpoints, and VAPID config

Configure VAPID from env only. Subscription endpoints are session-guarded; the public-key read is available to the client as needed.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated subscribe endpoint stores a PushSubscription for the owner; unsubscribe removes it
The public VAPID key is retrievable by the client
VAPID configuration is read from env only
Request specs cover subscribe/unsubscribe and auth gating

tasks.title: Daily digest builder and web-push dispatch job
tasks.description: solid_queue job that builds the daily digest from recently scored JobPosts and dispatches a VAPID-signed Web Push notification to stored subscriptions, configured as a recurring/scheduled job. Guard live sends behind VAPID key presence. In tests, mock the push client and never send a real push.
acceptance_criteria: Digest job selects recently scored JobPosts and calls the web-push client with VAPID
With no VAPID key or no subscriptions the job no-ops
A recurring schedule entry is configured for the daily digest
Job spec mocks web push; no real push is sent in tests

tasks.title: Approve and submit dispatch API
tasks.description: Authenticated POST /api/applications/:id/submit that requires explicit per-application approval, verifies the target ATS is supported and the autofill payload contains no unresolved unknown/sensitive fields, enqueues a worker-dispatch job with the structured payload, and records an AuditEvent. Never dispatches without explicit approval.
acceptance_criteria: Approved + supported + clean payload enqueues a worker dispatch, records an AuditEvent, and returns 200
Missing approval is refused (422); unsupported ATS is refused
Unauthenticated request returns 401
Request spec covers approval-required, unsupported-target, and auth cases; no submit occurs without approval

tasks.title: Worker task pull and status-report API
tasks.description: Worker-bearer-authenticated endpoints for the worker to pull approved submit tasks (structured payloads) and to report status, screenshots, and logs back, updating Application status and writing AuditEvents. Uses the WORKER_SERVICE_TOKEN bearer guard from AUTH-01; the human session cookie is not accepted here.
acceptance_criteria: Worker fetches approved tasks with a valid bearer token
Report endpoint updates Application status and stores audit artifacts (screenshots/logs references)
Missing/invalid bearer returns 401; the human session cookie is rejected
Request specs cover pull and report paths

tasks.title: Worker poll loop with bearer auth and fetch/report wiring
tasks.description: Implement the worker entrypoint poll loop (WORKER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS) that authenticates to Rails with Authorization: Bearer <WORKER_SERVICE_TOKEN>, pulls approved tasks from SUBMIT-02, dispatches them to the ATS handler registry, and reports a TaskResult (status/reason/screenshots/logs) back. Idles/exits cleanly when API_INTERNAL_URL is unset. No business logic beyond orchestration.
acceptance_criteria: Worker polls and fetches approved tasks using the bearer token
Tasks are routed to the ATS handler registry and results reported back
Unset API_INTERNAL_URL results in a clean idle/exit, not a crash
Worker tests and typecheck pass

tasks.title: Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby ATS fill handlers via safety gating
tasks.description: Implement per-ATS handlers for Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby in src/ats/, each implementing the AtsHandler interface and registered in the registry. Fill forms from the backend-generated autofill payload through src/safety.ts gating; pause or fail safely on unknown or sensitive fields; capture screenshots and logs for an auditable TaskResult. Never auto-submit beyond the approved payload.
acceptance_criteria: Handlers for greenhouse, lever, and ashby are registered and fill from the autofill payload via safety partitioning
Unknown or sensitive fields cause a pause with a reason rather than a guess
Each attempt returns a TaskResult with screenshots and logs
Playwright fixture tests plus pause/fail tests pass; typecheck clean

tasks.title: LinkedIn Easy Apply handler behind feature flag

acceptance_criteria: Handler is inactive when LINKEDIN_EASY_APPLY_ENABLED is off and active when on
Safety gating and auditable TaskResult contract are enforced
Tests cover both flag states; typecheck clean

tasks.title: Contact candidates and outreach drafts API

tasks.title: JobPost feed/detail and digest read endpoints
tasks.description: Add session-guarded read endpoints the PWA needs: GET /api/job_posts (scored job feed), GET /api/job_posts/:id (detail with scored fields + resolved ApplicationRoute), and GET /api/digest (latest daily digest of recently scored JobPosts). Consistent JSON error shape; 401 without a session. WEB-02 shipped against this contract before it existed (see ARCHITECTURE.md pending-endpoints note).

GET /api/digest returns the latest daily digest built from recently scored JobPosts (no LLM call on read)

No sensitive PII is exposed in any read payload
Request specs cover feed, detail, digest, and auth gating
